title: 第五章 活脱脱的勾引
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
萧姚还在不停往外散财。法器防具、稀世珍宝，或浮夸或鸡肋，一股脑通通塞过去。

    提前投资，主动攻略。砸钱买命，她不心疼！

    苍岚手上沉甸甸的，都快要捧不住了，连连叫停：

    “姐姐姐姐，这……这太贵重了，我不能要。”

    苍岚一手往回推拒，一手轻轻搭上萧姚的手腕，一脸认真地劝说：

    “姐姐，我知道你待我好，可……那些人如果知道你这么护着我，我担心他们会迁怒你啊。”

    “姐姐，你攒下这些法器不容易，我不想成为你进入内门的阻碍，姐姐你把它们都收回去好不好？”

    “你不想要？”

    萧姚手上一顿，语气转冷，带上些许被忤逆的不悦，慢慢抬起头，对上一双真诚干净的眼瞳。

    苍岚的笑容又软又暖，像三月暖阳一般。

    “姐姐，我已经习惯了。比起自保，我更怕你会受伤。”

    萧姚的心不受控地提起，又沉沉坠落。

    “其实，姐姐能亲自为我上药，我已经很感激了。”

    “如果让姐姐受累，苍岚心里会难过的。”

    苍岚的尾巴配合地跟着摇了摇，从背后甩出，软软搭在两人面前。

    万年玉髓是生肌续骨的神药，用在苍岚的尾巴上，委实是大材小用了。

    不过片刻功夫，伤口便完好如初，一点疤痕都没有留下。

    “姐姐你看！”

    苍岚的尾巴又抖了抖，尾尖刻意在萧姚眼前晃来晃去。

    萧姚毫不客气，抬手握住尾巴中段，顺着绒毛的长势撸下来，在尾尖上方停住，手腕一翻，把尾巴尖杵在眼前。

    确实是大好了。

    萧姚松了口气，理直气壮地又撸了一把尾巴，动作行云流水，纨绔又风流。

    敏感的尾巴被人随意把玩，苍岚忍不住抖了一下，脸颊上飞起薄红。

    “姐姐……有点痒……”

    萧姚意犹未尽地松开手。

    苍岚条件反射猛地一抽，尾巴瞬间蓬起，擦过萧姚耳畔，贴着她的下颌掠过，最后尾尖在她的脖领上蜻蜓点水般一扫而过。

    萧姚脸上也不由腾起热意，眼神都呆滞了。

    绒毛所过之处带来触电般的麻痒，撩人的触觉挥之不去。
content_en:
Xiao Yao is still spreading money away. Magical weapons, armors, rare treasures, exaggerated or useless, all were shoved in the way.

    Invest in advance and take the initiative. She doesn't feel bad about spending money to buy her life!

    Cang Lan's hands were so heavy that she could hardly hold them, and she repeatedly called to stop:

    "Sister, sister, this... this is too valuable, I can't have it."

    Cang Lan pushed back with one hand and gently put her other hand on Xiao Yao's wrist, persuading her seriously:

    "Sister, I know you treat me well, but... if those people know that you are protecting me like this, I'm worried that they will be angry with you."

    "Sister, it's not easy for you to accumulate these magic weapons. I don't want to be an obstacle for you to enter the inner door. Sister, can you take them all back?"

    "You don't want it?"

    Xiao Yao paused, his tone turned cold, with a little displeasure at being disobeyed, he slowly raised his head and met a pair of sincere and clean eyes.

    Cang Lan's smile was soft and warm, like the warm sunshine in March.

    "Sister, I'm used to it. I'm more afraid that you will get hurt than protecting myself."

    Xiao Yao's heart lifted uncontrollably, then fell again.

    "Actually, I'm very grateful that my sister can give me the medicine herself."

    "If my sister is affected, Cang Lan will feel sad."

    Cang Lan's tail shook in response, swung out from behind, and rested softly in front of the two of them.

    Ten-thousand-year chalcedony is a magic medicine for muscle growth and bone regeneration, but using it on Cang Lan's tail is really overkill.

    In just a moment, the wound was intact as before, leaving no scar at all.

    "Sister, look!"

    Cang Lan's tail twitched again, and the tip of her tail dangled deliberately in front of Xiao Yao's eyes.

    Xiao Yao was not polite, raised his hand to hold the middle part of the tail, and pulled it down along the length of the down, stopped above the tip of the tail, flipped his wrist, and held the tip of the tail in front of his eyes.

    It's really great.

    Xiao Yao breathed a sigh of relief and confidently stroked his tail again. His movements were smooth and dandy.

    Cang Lan couldn't help but tremble because her sensitive tail was being played with randomly, and a thin blush appeared on her cheeks.

    "Sister...it's a little itchy..."

    Xiao Yao still let go of his hand.

    Cang Lan's conditioned reflex twitched suddenly, her tail instantly fluffed up, brushed against Xiao Yao's ears, brushed against her chin, and finally the tail tip swept over her neck like a dragonfly.

    Xiao Yao couldn't help but feel warm on his face, and his eyes were dull.

    Wherever the fuzz passes, it brings an electric shock-like tingling, and the sultry touch is lingering.
